gmod_off: The global moderation module is not running.
duration_range: The duration is outside the allowed range.
gmute_needs_duration: A global timeout needs a duration.
sanction_exists: An active sanction of this kind already exists (#{id}).
guild_gone: The bot is no longer on that server.
guild_blacklisted: Because of the blacklist it cannot come back either.
ai_on: AI features (AI moderation, AI chat, ticket AI assistant) are now allowed on this server.
ai_off: AI features are now blocked on this server (AI triage keeps working).
guild_reloaded: The server's settings, permissions and lists were reloaded.
feed_off: Unknown platform, or the notification module is not running.
channel_unseen: The channel doesn't exist, or the bot can't see it.
role_icons_tier: Discord only allows role icons from boost level 2 (7 boosts on the server).
no_manage_roles: The bot is missing the Manage Roles permission.
aimod_off: The AI moderation module is not running.
allowlist_full: The list of allowed terms is full.
bg_removed: Background removed — the card uses the default background.
bg_saved: New background saved — the next card will show it.
resync_started: Command resync started (per server, in the server's language).
resync_mode: Only available in global or per-server command mode.
not_on_guild: The bot is not on this server.
old_panel_not_deleted: Couldn't delete the previous panel — if it's still there, delete it by hand.
old_panel_not_found: Couldn't look for the previous panel (missing Read Message History) — if it's still there, delete it by hand.
panel_post_failed: The panel couldn't be posted to #{channel}: {error}
channel_missing: The channel doesn't exist (deleted?) or the bot can't see it — pick another one.
not_text_channel: #{channel} is not a text channel — pick a text or announcement channel.
channel_hidden: The bot can't see #{channel} — give it the View Channel permission.
cannot_write: The bot can't write in #{channel} — missing: {missing}.
module_off: The {module} module isn't running on the bot — the panel's buttons wouldn't work.
bug_posted: The bug report panel is posted: #{channel}.
honeypot_posted: The trap channel's card is posted: #{channel}.
ticket_channel_first: First pick and save the panel's channel (Panel tab).
pick_channel: Pick a channel for the panel.
image_too_big: The image can be at most 8 MB.
image_type: Only PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP images can be uploaded.
no_change_nick: The bot doesn't have the Change Nickname permission on this server.
timeout: Timed out: the bot didn't finish within {seconds} s (is Discord slow?) — check the result on Discord and try again if needed.
restarted: The bot restarted while running this — try again.
ctl_restart_busy: A restart is already in progress.
ctl_restarting: Clean restart{process} in a few seconds — it reports back in about half a minute.
ctl_no_git: The bot isn't running from a git clone (or git is missing) — update it from the hosting panel.
ctl_update_busy: An update is already in progress.
ctl_up_to_date: No new commit on {branch} — the bot runs the latest code ({sha}).
ctl_pulled_multi: Pulled: {sha} ({branch}){note}. Several processes are running — restart the WHOLE bot (hosting panel or Pterodactyl “Restart”) so all of them run the new code.
ctl_updated: Updated: {sha} ({branch}){note}. Clean restart in a few seconds.
ctl_not_loaded: {name} isn't loaded (only running modules or ones that failed at startup can be reloaded).
ctl_others_follow: The other processes follow within half a minute.
